plan: I will use the Nash equilibrium bidding strategy for this game. With 3 bidders, the optimal bidding strategy is to bid two-thirds of your value. My value is $22, so I will bid 2/3 * 22 = 14.666... Since bids must be in $0.1 increments, I will bid $14.7.
